objective: Make the real Hina desktop widget practical across restarts without adding chrome to the avatar: persist only its validated screen position in Electron userData, restore it inside an available multi-monitor work area, and add typed Operator-window controls to show, hide or reset the widget position.
non_goals: Do not add another control, close button, title bar, settings card or status label on the widget itself.
Do not persist avatar, conversation, safety, audio, user text, monitor names or other personal content.
Do not accept arbitrary paths or arbitrary window coordinates from the renderer.
Do not add tray lifecycle, auto-start, click-through mode, resize/scale settings or a new dependency.
Do not open M08 or run the deferred frozen OBS benchmark/eight-hour soak.
contracts: The state file path is fixed under Electron app userData and contains only schemaVersion, x and y integers.
Malformed, oversized, non-integer or unknown-version state fails closed to the current primary-display default without preventing desktop startup.
Restored coordinates are clamped fully inside the nearest currently available display work area, including negative-coordinate displays and display removal.
Native drag remains the only way the widget chooses arbitrary coordinates; renderer controls may request only show, hide or reset_position.
Only the trusted Operator main frame may invoke widget-control IPC; the widget renderer cannot hide, move or reset its own native window through IPC.
Position writes are debounced and bounded; failures are logged with a stable error code and do not crash the avatar.
Show uses non-activating behavior where supported so the widget does not steal typing focus from the owner.
The widget visual contract remains unchanged: transparent avatar plus exactly one hover/focus Voice control.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Electron BrowserWindow/screen/app APIs and Node fs/promises/path.
Existing Vue operator shell and named preload boundary.
No new dependency, network source, model, texture or copied upstream implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Pure unit tests prove valid restore, malformed fallback, coordinate clamping, negative-coordinate display support and display-removal recovery.
Dragging the native widget schedules a debounced write of only schemaVersion/x/y to the fixed userData state path.
Restart restores the previous valid widget position inside an available work area.
The Operator panel explains and exposes show, hide and reset-position controls through named preload IPC.
Widget-control IPC rejects invocation from the widget renderer and rejects actions outside the fixed allowlist.
The widget still contains exactly one hover/focus Voice control and no new widget chrome.
Desktop typecheck, unit/security tests and one real Electron smoke pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py"
